name: Snake Charmer
ability: Each night, choose an alive player: a chosen Demon swaps characters & alignments with you & is then poisoned.
interaction: Chooses one alive player. If that player is the Demon, both are woken and shown YOU ARE with their new character token and their new alignment (thumbs up/down); otherwise nothing is learned.
drunk_or_poisoned: Choosing the Demon does nothing: no swap occurs and the Demon is not poisoned. The Snake Charmer is not told.

rulings.text: Choosing a non-Demon (e.g. the Pit-Hag) does nothing.
On a swap, the Snake Charmer becomes the evil Demon and the old Demon becomes a good Snake Charmer marked POISONED; the poisoning persists (the token stays).
Alignments swap to match: an evil Snake Charmer (e.g. created by the Pit-Hag) that charms the Fang Gu swaps characters and both remain evil.
A Philosopher who gained the Snake Charmer ability and charms the Demon becomes the Demon; the old Demon becomes a poisoned Philosopher.

test_scenarios.name: charm the Imp
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Snake Charmer, Bob Imp, Carol Empath, Dave Poisoner, Eve Chef.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice becomes the evil Imp and Bob the good Snake Charmer with the POISONED reminder; both are shown YOU ARE and their alignment. Alice, as Imp, chooses the kill later that night.

test_scenarios.name: miss
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Snake Charmer, Bob Imp, Carol Empath, Dave Poisoner.
test_scenarios.expected: Nothing happens; no swap and Alice learns nothing.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned Snake Charmer
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Snake Charmer, Bob Imp, Dave Poisoner, Carol Empath.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Dave poisons Alice; Alice chooses Bob.
test_scenarios.expected: No swap; Bob remains the healthy Imp and Alice the Snake Charmer.

test_scenarios.name: old Demon cannot swap back
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Snake Charmer, Bob Imp, Carol Empath.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Alice charms Bob. Night 3: Bob (now poisoned Snake Charmer) chooses Alice (now Imp).
test_scenarios.expected: Bob is poisoned, so no swap; Alice stays the Imp.

test_scenarios.name: Vigormortis swap
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Snake Charmer, Bob Vigormortis, Carol Mathematician.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice becomes the evil Vigormortis; Bob becomes a good, poisoned Snake Charmer.
